name: Kaung Myat Kyaw
about: Highly motivated Software Engineer with a Master’s in Computer Science (GPA 4.0) from the University of Colorado Boulder, skilled in full-stack development, backend systems, and high-performance C++ programming. Experienced in building scalable web applications, AI agentic servers, and optimized data structures like LRU caches, with strong expertise in Python, C++, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL/NoSQL, and cloud deployment (AWS). Demonstrated ability to improve system performance, implement multithreaded and read-optimized solutions, and deliver robust, user-focused software in Agile environments. I’m also passionate about using AI to solve meaningful problems and enjoy working on teams that value innovation, performance, and social impact.
